summary: Initialize M1 non-notch context and guidelines
description: Created CONTEXT.md defining MacBook M1 non-notch constraints (safeAreaInsets.top == 0, dynamic menu bar height alignment, hover bounds) and codebase architecture rules.

Added a freeform Notion-style block editor inside the notch canvas with slash commands (/), instant markdown checklist triggers ([]), interactive checkboxes with strikethrough, atomic debounced JSON persistence, notch dismissal protection while editing, and a dedicated Settings pane.

summary: Add GitHub Actions automated app build workflow
description: Added .github/workflows/build_app.yml to automatically build, ad-hoc sign, and package boringNotch into a downloadable zip artifact on push.

summary: Fix window key focus, dismissal lifecycle, tab transitions, and scratchpad typing
description: Enabled canBecomeKey=true on BoringNotchWindow and BoringNotchSkyLightWindow, added Esc key (keyCode 53) and global mouse click-outside dismissal monitors, removed buggy preventNotchClose state locking, implemented macOS 14+ onKeyPress for arrow keys and backspace navigation in NotchPadBlockRow, and smoothed currentView tab transitions.

summary: Fix NotchPad scroll dismissal and keyboard focus routing
description: Guarded handleUpGesture against coordinator.currentView == .pad to prevent trackpad scrolling from triggering the close gesture animation and dismissal. Added claimKeyFocus() and NSApp.deactivate() on close in BoringViewModel, and auto-focus with Escape key handling in NotchPadView.

summary: Implement critical battery (<10%) glowing red notch with rotating dramatic messages
description: Added an urgent critical battery alert state (<10% battery, discharging) that turns the notch completely red with a red glowing shadow and white alert text. Includes rotating funny/dramatic messages ('Charge your laptop you moron! 😡', 'Don't Let me Die 😔', etc.), dynamic chin widening, physical notch cutout adaptation, and a preview toggle in Settings.

summary: Implement Pomodoro Timer ('Poronodo Timer') with live notch tracking and radiant green completion pulse
description: Added dedicated Pomodoro Timer tab with preset selectors (10m, 20m, 30m, Custom duration stepper), animated circular progress ring, start/pause/resume/reset controls, celebration overlay with rotating messages ('Your Session is Complete ✨🎉'), native system completion sound chimes ('Hero' / 'Glass'), closed notch live countdown display ('⏳ mm:ss'), and glowing radiant green pulse on the closed notch when complete.

summary: Implement native YouTube Music tab with InnerTube search, headless playback engine, closed notch visualizer, and safe Google Sign-In
description: Added dedicated YouTube Music tab in the notch with instant native InnerTube search (WEB_REMIX client), headless WebKit playback engine (WKWebView running YouTube IFrame API with desktop Safari UA), track scrubber and queue navigation, closed notch live activity and audio spectrum syncing, and an isolated WebKit Google Sign-In sheet supporting YouTube Premium ad-free streaming.
